name: POISE-3
question: Does perioperative intravenous tranexamic acid reduce major bleeding without exceeding a prespecified cardiovascular safety margin after noncardiac surgery?

design.population: 9,535 patients aged 45 years or older undergoing inpatient noncardiac surgery with bleeding and cardiovascular risk factors; creatinine clearance below 30 ml/min or long-term dialysis excluded.
design.description: Multicenter randomized bleeding-superiority and cardiovascular-noninferiority trial; recruitment stopped after 9,535 of 10,000 planned randomizations because of a pandemic-related financial deficit, without knowledge of trial results
design.locator: Full text, Methods, Patients, p 1987; Statistical Analysis, p 1988; Results, Patients, Follow-up, and Adherence, p 1989

verdictNote: Bleeding superiority was met; cardiovascular noninferiority was not established.
takeaway: In noncardiac surgery, intravenous tranexamic acid reduced the 30-day composite of life-threatening, major, or critical-organ bleeding versus placebo; the prespecified noninferiority margin for the cardiovascular composite was not met.

reports.label: Primary tranexamic-acid report
reports.citation: Devereaux PJ, Marcucci M, Painter TW, et al. "Tranexamic Acid in Patients Undergoing Noncardiac Surgery." *N Engl J Med.* 2022;386(21):1986-1997. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2201171

results.measure: Life-threatening, major, or critical-organ bleeding by 30 days
results.note: Intention-to-treat analysis. Absolute risk difference −2.6 percentage points (95% CI −3.8 to −1.4); two-sided superiority test.
results.locator: Full text, Statistical Analysis, p 1988; Table 2, p 1991

results.measure: Myocardial injury, nonhemorrhagic stroke, peripheral arterial thrombosis, or symptomatic proximal VTE by 30 days
results.note: Per-protocol analysis of patients receiving both doses; noninferiority required a one-sided 97.5% CI upper bound below 1.125 and one-sided P <0.025; observed upper bound 1.14. P is one-sided for noninferiority. Absolute risk difference 0.3 percentage points (95% CI −1.1 to 1.7). Intention-to-treat sensitivity HR 1.03 (95% CI 0.92 to 1.14); nonhemorrhagic stroke 24/4757 versus 16/4778 and symptomatic proximal VTE 32/4757 versus 28/4778.
results.locator: Full text, Statistical Analysis, p 1988; Primary Outcomes, p 1989; Table 2, p 1991

results.note: Component of the primary bleeding composite; secondary analysis without multiplicity adjustment.

results.measure: Transfusion of at least 1 unit of packed red cells by 30 days
results.note: Tertiary outcome; confidence interval not adjusted for multiplicity.

harms.label: Serious adverse events
harms.locator: Full text, Secondary and Tertiary Outcomes and Serious Adverse Events, p 1993

harms.label: Seizure
harms.note: HR 3.35 (95% CI 0.92 to 12.20); tertiary outcome, not adjusted for multiplicity.

harms.label: Infection
harms.note: HR 1.03 (95% CI 0.91 to 1.17); tertiary outcome, not adjusted for multiplicity.

delivery.label: Tranexamic-acid dosing
delivery.value: 1 g intravenous bolus at the start and 1 g at the end of surgery; placebo at the same times. Both assigned doses received by 96.3% of patients in each arm.
delivery.locator: Full text, Procedures, p 1987; Results, Patients, Follow-up, and Adherence, p 1989

reports.label: Prespecified urologic subgroup
